blocks.text: A DINO step updates the student by gradient, the teacher by EMA, and the center from old teacher logits. The task is: Run one small original-DINO step with supplied BN-free, dropout-free matching networks returning [B,K]. If teacher is None, deepcopy/freeze the student. The first two aligned views are global; the student sees all views. Optimize student, EMA-update teacher using the NEW student, update center from OLD raw teacher logits, and return (loss,teacher,new_center). This is the training core, not DINOv3 pretraining; caller owns augmentation and checkpoints.

The inputs are `student`, `teacher`, `views`, `optimizer`, `center`, `momentum`, `center_momentum`, `teacher_temp`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
